head: codex/5701-runtime-v3-openapi-contracts
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][api] Define Runtime v3 OpenAPI contracts (#5701)
body:
Closes #5701

## Summary

Defines the complete versioned Runtime v3 Core and Observatory OpenAPI 3.1 contracts and serves them from the real guardian-launched Axum/Tokio/Rustls listener. The runtime now exposes embedded raw contracts and Swagger UI, authenticated health and metrics, signed control, Observatory HTTP/WSS, and full-duplex ACIP WSS with bounded Protobuf frames and canonical ingress dispatch. The guardian kernel is the sole production API documentation authority.

## Validation

- Kernel control routes: 21/21 passed.
- Guardian soak: 7/7 passed.
- OpenAPI contract suite: 6/6 passed.
- Real Observatory WSS: 6/6 passed.
- adl-runtime library: 134/134 passed.
- Runtime API WSS: 2/2 passed.
- Strict all-target Clippy passed for both Runtime crates; git diff --check passed.
- Live HTTPS proof on port 20997 returned both Swagger UIs, authenticated health, and authenticated metrics with HTTP 200.
- Gemini 3.1 Pro API review passed after remediation.
- Final integrated-head GPT-5.5 review passed with zero findings at f6c9d63ecd62a837a951e4106f964f215e7b64e6.

## Notes

The HTML Observatory remains a separate client. Documentation assets are embedded in the Rust runtime binary and require no Python process, sidecar server, or runtime CDN. Observatory snapshot HTTP authentication, first-frame WSS authentication, signed text control, and authenticated ACIP binary ingress are documented as distinct security boundaries.
